Order.title: Order
Order.description: Represents a Rubik/Cubing product order identified by a tracking code (Mã vận đơn) created by SHOP TAH Admin.

orderCode.description: Unique tracking code (Mã vận đơn) issued by SHOP TAH.

productName.description: Name of the Rubik cube or speedcubing gear ordered.

productCategory.description: Category of the Rubik product (e.g., 3x3 Flagship MagLev, 4x4 Magnetic, Timer & Lube).

customerLabel.description: Display label or note for the buyer without exposing raw PII.

status.description: Current fulfillment status of the order.

confirmed.description: Whether the tracking code is confirmed and active for buyer chat and status lookup.

shopName.description: Unified shop identity, always SHOP TAH.

adminEmail.description: Verified SHOP TAH Google account email that created or updated the order.

adminGateKey.description: Admin secret password gate key verified during Step 1.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the tracking code was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the order status was last updated.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: A persistent chat message pinned to a specific tracking code between Buyer and SHOP TAH. Supports text and images (no video clips).

orderCode.description: Tracking code (Mã vận đơn) pinned to this chat thread.

senderName.description: Display name of sender (SHOP TAH for admin, or Buyer label).

imageUrl.description: Optional compressed image Data URL (strictly image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp, image/gif; video clips forbidden).

adminEmail.description: Verified SHOP TAH Google account email when senderRole is ADMIN.

adminGateKey.description: Admin secret password gate key verified during Step 1 when senderRole is ADMIN.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was sent.

ProductReview.title: ProductReview
ProductReview.description: A buyer product review and feedback entry linked to a verified tracking code.

orderCode.description: Verified tracking code used to submit the review.

comment.description: Detailed feedback on corner-cutting, magnet strength, UV grip, and packaging.

imageUrl.description: Optional photo of the unboxed Rubik cube (no video clips).

adminEmail.description: Verified SHOP TAH Google account email when replying to a review.

adminGateKey.description: Admin secret password gate key verified during Step 1 when replying to a review.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the review was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the review was last updated.

/orders/{orderCode}.description: Stores tracking codes (Mã vận đơn) and order statuses managed by SHOP TAH Admin and looked up by buyers.

/orders/{orderCode}/messages/{messageId}.description: Subcollection of persistent chat messages pinned to tracking code {orderCode} between Buyer and SHOP TAH.

/orders/{orderCode}/reviews/{reviewId}.description: Subcollection of product reviews and feedback linked to tracking code {orderCode}.
